name: Tau-Zenet Adjat
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with a "Zenet" card. Cannot be destroyed by card effects, while equipped with an Equip Card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Tau-Zenet Adjat" once per turn. You can discard this card; send 1 "Zenet" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Tau-Zenet Adjat". (Quick Effect): You can send up to 3 face-up Normal Monster Cards you control to the GY, then target that many cards your opponent controls; return them to the hand, then you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY.
